mock.description: The mock the comment is on (a link to its row).

step.description: The step id the comment is on.

decision.description: The decision id it answers (D2), when it answers one.

anchor.description: The element the comment is on, when the reviewer pointed at one.

screenshot.description: An image the reviewer attached or pasted.

element_shot.description: A picture of the pointed-at element as it looked (best effort).

status.description: open: saved, not sent; submitted: sent to the building session; addressed: the mock was revised for it.
